# SCI-POINT ODQ-003A/003B Scientific-Owner Direction

Record identity: `SCI-POINT-ODQ-003A-003B-DIRECTION-2026-09-02`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Status: two ODQ-003 subdecisions decided; remaining observation-local parent
admission subsequently closed by
`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_ODQ_003_APPROVAL_2026-09-02.md`

## ODQ-003A — FRUIT Is Lineage, Not A POINT Parent Type

The owner directed that FRUIT should always terminate with a map type such as
MAP, JINC, or FLT. SCI-POINT therefore does not define FRUIT as a separate
parent family.

When a POINT input is the terminal result of a FRUIT procedure, its immediate
scientific product type remains its exact terminal MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, or
FLT-MATCHED type. Complete FRUIT method, terminal-iteration, generation,
response, support, uncertainty, and lineage identity remains required
ancestry. Removing FRUIT from the POINT parent-type list does not erase or
flatten that ancestry.

This is a POINT consumer-admission rule. It does not edit, freeze, or make a
claim about the active SCI-FRUIT package.

## ODQ-003B — Coadds Deferred

The owner directed that SCI-POINT v0.1 may forego coadd parents. Base v0.1
therefore admits only observation-local per-array parent candidates. Coadd
fitting may be considered in a future successor with a separate estimand,
association, response/covariance, and use boundary.

## Question Subsequently Closed

The proposed observation-local parent set was subsequently approved in
`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_ODQ_003_APPROVAL_2026-09-02.md`: MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, and
FLT-MATCHED are eligible as distinct explicit POINT method routes with no
automatic selection, substitution, equivalence, or fallback.

## Non-Effects

At issuance, this direction did not admit any numerical parent route, prove
compatibility, answer the remaining ODQ-003 question or ODQ-004 through
ODQ-009, launch Stage B, change an algorithm, or establish implementation
conformity, validation, achieved performance, readiness, or production state.
The later ODQ-003 approval establishes family eligibility only and preserves
the numerical-availability and exact-binding gates.
